n. (-रं)
1 A sort of crown or tiara.
2

The illusion of a demon.
E.
हि to go, रक् aff.

A buffalo.
3 A hero inflated with his own valour and prowess.
4 A Buddha or Bauddha deity.
E.
हे calling or defying, रवि to sound, aff. अच्.

f. (-नी)
DURGĀ.
E.
हेरम्ब GAṆEŚA, and जननी mother.

m. (-ट्टः)
A country included in the enumeration of the provinces of the Dekhin.
E.
हेरम्ब GAṆEŚA, and हट्ट fair.

m. (-कः)
A spy, a secret emissary or agent.

m. (-कः)
1 An attendant on Mahākāla, or ŚIVA in that form.
2 An inferior divinity of the Bauddhas.
